description: The NormalizedIter trims trailing spaces in new() rather than at emit time, so the main loop never has to distinguish 'is this the last space'. A contributor might suggest 'simplify' by checking trailing in next() — this would re-introduce the trailing-space bug. The current design is correct and deliberate.
title: NormalizedIter: zero-allocation, correct trailing-space semantics
